ts_sales_disabled: Keep on. Hides buy buttons, quick add, the cart icon and the cart, sends the cart page home, and stops cart and checkout requests in the browser.
cart_type: No effect while Block cart and checkout is on: the cart drawer isn't drawn and the cart page goes to the home page.
show_accelerated_checkout_buttons: Express payment buttons, such as Shop Pay, in the cart. Not shown while Block cart and checkout is on.
empty_cart_button_link: Where the button of an empty cart goes. Not shown while Block cart and checkout is on.
